overall_goal: Heat oil in a frying pan and cook the bacon medallions, turning them occasionally until browned.

goals.description: Prepare the frying pan, oil, and bacon packets.
goals.rationale: The person places the frying pan on the hob, retrieves the bacon packets, and adds oil to the pan to prepare for cooking.

goals.description: Add the bacon medallions to the frying pan.
goals.rationale: The person opens the bacon packets and places the unsmoked and smoked bacon medallions into the heated frying pan.

goals.description: Flip and adjust the bacon medallions for the first time.
goals.rationale: The person uses a spatula to flip the bacon medallions and adjust their positions to ensure even cooking.

goals.description: Flip, scrape fat, and adjust the bacon medallions for the second time.
goals.rationale: The person flips the bacon again, scrapes off excess fat, adjusts their positions, and shakes the pan to prevent sticking.

goals.description: Flip and adjust the bacon medallions for the third time.
goals.rationale: The person flips the bacon medallions one more time, adjusts their spacing in the pan, and taps the spatula to clean it.
